question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Apple)

calls.reasoning: Apple guided Sept-quarter FY26 revenue +9-11% YoY on $102.47B => ~$111.7-113.7B. Consensus ~$112.95-113.6B (MarketBeat $113.31B, Zacks $112.95B, Visible Alpha $113.6B, Goldman $113.6B). Apple has recently landed at/above the top of guidance (Q1 FY26 big beat; Q3 FY26 $109.4B vs ~$109B consensus, 16.4% YoY), but this quarter is supply-constrained (memory, low channel inventory) with ~2.5pt FX headwind, limiting upside. iPhone guided mid-teens growth; iPhone Duo foldable launched after quarter end. Median set slightly above consensus at ~$114.0B. calls.reconciliation: All three dossiers agree on the factual inputs (guidance 9-11% => $111.7-113.7B, consensus $112.95-113.6B, Q3 FY26 beat ~0.5%, Duo excluded, no market). The only disputes are judgment: (1) the size of the beat over guidance and consensus: recent beats were large but this quarter is supply-constrained, and Q4 FY25 hit the low end, so I take ~$113.85B, matching run 3 and slightly below runs 1-2; (2) the lower-tail escape: a low-end-of-guide result (~$111.7B) has precedent, so p_below=0.06; (3) the upper escape above $118B needs a >4% beat in a supply-limited quarter, so 0.02. I carried the runs' reference class and ~$3.5B dispersion forward. No web retrieval this run.
